name: Will installing a new vanity require changing my bathroom's plumbing?

mainEntity.name: Will installing a new vanity require changing my bathroom's plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a new vanity may or may not require changes to your bathroom's plumbing, depending on the new vanity's configuration relative to the existing hookups. If your new vanity has a different sink placement, size, or style (e.g., switching from a single to a double sink), adjustments to the water supply lines and drain pipes may be necessary. Our team can assess this during a consultation to determine if plumbing modifications are needed for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing changes might be needed if your new vanity's configuration differs significantly from the existing setup.
